name: Kinline family history
summary: Family history databases with census, military and immigration records.
body:
Kinline works on any library computer. From home, sign in with your card number and PIN at the Kinline gateway, which the library renews each year (demo).

Library edition code for the demo: OPL-KIN-2026.
access_note: Library computers, or at home with a card

name: Bramblebox e-books and audiobooks
summary: About 40,000 e-books and audiobooks to borrow on a phone, tablet or e-reader.
body:
Install the Bramblebox app, choose Ossingford Public Library, and sign in with your card number and PIN. You can borrow up to 10 titles at a time for 14 days.

Holds limit: 15. Titles return themselves, so there are no late fees.

name: County map collection
summary: Scanned county and city maps from 1880 to 1950, free to view and download.
body: Every map is scanned at 600 dpi and can be downloaded for personal use. Prints can be ordered at the Ledger Room desk.

name: Desk procedures handbook
summary: How we check out, renew, waive, and handle a lost card at every desk.
body:
Chapter 4 changed on October 26: replacement cards are now free once a year. The full handbook PDF is on the staff drive (demo).

Questions go to the circulation supervisor, Dev Anand (fictional).

name: Homework Help Live
summary: Live tutors in math, science and writing, 2 pm to 10 pm every day.
body:
Open Tutorwell from the library site, sign in with a card, and pick a subject. Sessions are chat-based and can be saved as a transcript.

Library edition code for the demo: OPL-TUTOR.

name: Incident and safety guide
summary: What to do, who to call, and how to write it up.
body: Call the building lead first, then security if needed. Incident reports go into the staff form within 24 hours. The on-call manager rota is in the staff room.

name: Reelhouse film streaming
summary: Documentaries, classic films and kids' shows, 8 plays a month.
body: Sign in with your card. Plays reset on the first of each month. Kids' titles do not count toward the limit.

name: Language lab
summary: Self-paced lessons in 40 languages, including English for Spanish speakers.
body: Free for everyone in Ossingford County, no card needed. Make an account with any e-mail address.

name: Newspaper archive: Ossingford Ledger
summary: Every issue of the Ledger from 1874 to 1979, searchable by name and date.
body: Search by name, street or date. Full pages can be printed in the Ledger Room.

name: Program room booking sheet
summary: Who has the Kettle Room, the community rooms and the makerspace, by week.
body: Staff book rooms for programs here before the monthly calendar closes on the 20th. Community groups book in person at the desk.

name: Research databases
summary: Magazines, newspapers, consumer reports and encyclopedias in one search.
body: Use your card number to sign in. The most-used: Periodica (magazines), CarFacts (vehicle repair) and Wellread (literary criticism).

name: Seed library catalog
summary: What is in the oak card catalog drawers this month, and how to save seeds.
body: Take up to five packets a visit. Bring back seeds from what you grew.

name: Small business center
summary: Company and industry data, business plan samples and market research.
body: Sign in with a card. A business librarian is in the Kettle Room on the first Thursday of each month.

name: Weeding schedule
summary: Which shelves are being reviewed this month, by branch.
body: November: 600s at Central, picture books at Millrace, DVDs at Ferrin Heights. Withdrawn items go to the Friends' book sale.

name: Wi-Fi hotspot lending
summary: Borrow a hotspot for two weeks from any branch.
body: Ask at any desk. Hotspots are on the holds list; the wait is about a week.
